RETELLAI_CREATE_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.description: Tool to create a new knowledge base in Retell AI with texts, files, and URLs. Use when you need to create a knowledge base for an AI agent. At least one of knowledge_base_texts, knowledge_base_files, or knowledge_base_urls should be provided.

knowledge_base_name.description: Name of the knowledge base. Must be less than 40 characters.

knowledge_base_urls.description: URLs to be scraped and added to the knowledge base. Must be valid URLs.

name.description: The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service

s3key.description: The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service.

mimetype.description: The MIME type of the file

knowledge_base_files.description: Files to add to the knowledge base. Limit to 25 files, where each file is limited to 50MB.

text.description: The text content to add to the knowledge base

title.description: Title or label for this text entry

knowledge_base_texts.description: Texts to add to the knowledge base. Array of objects with text and title fields.

GMAIL_UPDATE_LABEL.description: Tool to update the properties of an existing Gmail label. Use when you need to modify label name, visibility settings, or color.

id.description: The ID of the label to update.

name.description: The display name of the label.

textColor.description: The text color of the label, represented as hex string. This field is required in order to set the color of a label. Only predefined Gmail color values are allowed. See: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/labels#color_palette

backgroundColor.description: The background color represented as hex string #RRGGBB (ex #000000). This field is required in order to set the color of a label. Only predefined Gmail color values are allowed. See: https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/labels#color_palette

color.description: Color settings for the label. Both backgroundColor and textColor must be provided together.

userId.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

labelListVisibility.description: Visibility of the label in the label list (Gmail sidebar).

messageListVisibility.description: Visibility of messages with this label in the message list.

GMAIL_CREATE_FILTER.description: Tool to create a new Gmail filter with specified criteria and actions. Use when the user wants to automatically organize incoming messages based on sender, subject, size, or other criteria. Note: you can only create a maximum of 1,000 filters per account.

forward.description: Email address that the message should be forwarded to.

addLabelIds.description: List of label IDs to add to the message.

removeLabelIds.description: List of label IDs to remove from the message.

action.description: REQUIRED. Action that the filter will perform on messages matching the criteria. At least one action field must be specified.

user_id.description: The user's email address or the special value 'me' to indicate the authenticated user for whom the filter will be created.

to.description: The recipient's display name or email address. Includes recipients in the 'to', 'cc', and 'bcc' header fields. You can use simply the local part of the email address. For example, 'example' and 'example@' both match 'example@gmail.com'. This field is case-insensitive.

from.description: The sender's display name or email address.

size.description: The size of the entire RFC822 message in bytes, including all headers and attachments.

query.description: Only return messages matching the specified query. Supports the same query format as the Gmail search box. For example, 'from:someuser@example.com rfc822msgid: is:unread'.

subject.description: Case-insensitive phrase found in the message's subject. Trailing and leading whitespace are trimmed and adjacent spaces are collapsed.

excludeChats.description: Whether the response should exclude chats.

negatedQuery.description: Only return messages not matching the specified query. Supports the same query format as the Gmail search box.

hasAttachment.description: Whether the message has any attachment.

sizeComparison.description: How the message size should be compared to the size field.

criteria.description: REQUIRED. Message matching criteria that determines which messages the filter will apply to. At least one criteria field must be specified.
